typography.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-body font-semibold text-text_muted

components.navigation: Crystal glass sticky header, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#05050A]/60 border-b border-white/5
components.hero_section: Full viewport height, image background with bg-[#05050A]/60 overlay to ensure text contrast. Center aligned massive serif text. Minimalist primary CTA.
components.occasion_selector: Horizontal scrollable flex row of glassmorphic pills. Active state gets primary color border (border-[#4F46E5]) and slight text glow.
components.outfit_card: Portrait orientation (aspect-[3/4]). Image fills 100%. Dark gradient overlay at bottom for text readability. Reveal 'View Details' button on hover. Unconventional, bento-grid inspired placement.
components.controls: Shadcn Select/Dropdown heavily customized to have dark backgrounds (#0F0F16) and thin borders (border-white/10).
components.detail_view: Modal or expanded bento section with massive image focus, minimal text, showcasing styling rules.

hero_background.description: Abstract midnight blue silk background for the hero section.

empty_state.description: Luxurious empty wardrobe hanger for zero-results states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly apply Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) using the defined color palette in Tailwind config. Do NOT use default Tailwind colors, use the provided hex codes.
Use 'Playfair Display' for Headings and 'Outfit' for Body text. Install them via Google Fonts or next/font.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react with 'duotone' weight to give a high-end tech-fashion feel.
Add 'data-testid' to EVERY interactive element (buttons, toggles, outfit cards) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='occasion-selector-date').
The Hero Section must use the 'hero_background' media URL with a bg-[#05050A]/60 overlay to ensure the massive Playfair Display text is perfectly legible.
Outfit Cards must be implemented as pure HTML/Tailwind divs (not generic Shadcn Cards) to allow for edge-to-edge imagery with an aspect-[3/4] ratio.

Use raw HTML/Tailwind for structural bento layouts. Use Shadcn ONLY for complex interactives (like Select dropdowns for Gender/Season) and strip their default styles to match the dark glassmorphic theme.
Seed the frontend logic with the provided outfit images, mapping them to rule-based combinations (e.g., Occasion: College -> casual_college images).
Ensure the 'Occasion Selector' uses horizontal flex pills with 'Crystal Glass' effect (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/[0.03]).
Keep text minimal. The images are the hero. Never center text arbitrarily unless it's a hero heading.
